name: [WORLD 4!] 1 Plank = $1/s
desc:
💵 Start small with just a few planks and turn them into a massive money-making empire. Every plank earns you $1 per second—upgrade, rebirth, and build your way across the ocean!

Use Code "SEASONS!" for Free Money!

🎮 GAME MECHANICS:

-🪵 Buy planks to earn money
-🏗️ Build and expand your platform
-🔁 Rebirth to unlock multipliers
-📈 Grow your income and become rich! 
-🐾 Collect and hatch powerful pets
-✨ Enchant your planks for huge boosts!
-🌉 Contribute to the Server Bridge

✨ OTHER FEATURES:

-💰 Upgrades and boosts
-🌍 Global leaderboards
-🎁 Daily rewards
-⚡ Fast progression

Join the group for daily Rewards! Don't forget to Like and Favorite the game!
